description.zh: 稳态波函数在矩形势垒内指数衰减、墙后留有透射份额；透射概率随墙宽指数下降、随能量出现共振；含时波包撞墙分成反射与透射；扫描隧道显微镜用隧穿电流的指数灵敏度；质量越大概率越小。一维、非相对论、单粒子模型。
description.en: A steady wave function decays exponentially inside a rectangular barrier and leaves a transmitted share; transmission falls exponentially with width and shows resonances with energy; a wave packet splits at the wall; the scanning tunnelling microscope exploits the exponential sensitivity; heavier particles tunnel far less. A one-dimensional, non-relativistic, single-particle model.

label.zh: 入射波与反射波叠加成波纹
label.en: Incoming plus reflected waves make ripples

reason.zh: 第 0 步墙前的 |ψ|² 波纹，是入射波与反射波的干涉；与干涉页的叠加原理相同。
reason.en: The ripples of |ψ|² before the wall in step 0 are interference of the incoming and reflected waves, the same superposition as on the interference page.

label.zh: 数值解波动方程需要网格
label.en: Solving a wave equation numerically needs a grid

reason.zh: 第 3 步把连续的波用 360 个网格点表示并按固定步长推进，网格与步长的选择与采样页讲的离散化同类。
reason.en: Step 3 represents the continuous wave on 360 grid points advanced with a fixed step; choosing grid and step is the same kind of discretisation the sampling page discusses.

title.zh: 粒子没有足够能量，为什么还能穿过去？
title.en: Why can a particle pass without enough energy?
